title: Prompting for products: investigating design space exploration strategies for text-to-image generative models
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study investigates how users leverage text-to-image generative AI tools to explore and create feasible, novel, and aesthetic product designs. It analyzes users' actions in global and local editing modes and their impact on design outcomes.
exclusion_facts: The study does not collect subjective evaluations through author discussion, future research plans, or citations of existing studies.
